en.name: China Bridge Sprint
en.description: A six-week intensive for LATAM teams testing demand, validating positioning, and lining up distributors before committing to China.
en.detailSubtitle: A shorter, validation-focused sprint for teams that need answers before they commit budget to China entry.
en.metaTitle: China Bridge Sprint | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Six-week sprint for LATAM teams to validate demand, positioning, and distributor fit before entering China.
en.bodyHtml:
The China Bridge Sprint is a focused six weeks designed for teams that already see a signal in China but need to validate before they invest. We focus on three questions: real demand, the right positioning, and the right initial partner.

Who it's for

  • LATAM teams with early China interest and limited budget for exploration.
  • Operators who need a structured way to test before committing.
  • Founders preparing the next funding conversation with a concrete China thesis.

br.name: China Bridge Sprint
br.description: Sprint intensivo de seis semanas para times LATAM testarem demanda, validarem posicionamento e alinharem distribuidores antes de entrar na China.
br.detailSubtitle: Um sprint focado em validacao para times que precisam de respostas antes de comprometer orcamento com a entrada na China.
br.metaTitle: China Bridge Sprint | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Sprint de seis semanas para times LATAM validarem demanda, posicionamento e parceiros antes de entrar na China.
br.bodyHtml:
O China Bridge Sprint sao seis semanas focadas para times que ja veem sinal na China mas precisam validar antes de investir. Trabalhamos tres perguntas: demanda real, posicionamento certo e parceiro inicial correto.

Para quem e

  • Times LATAM com interesse inicial na China e orcamento limitado para exploracao.
  • Operadores que precisam de uma forma estruturada de testar antes de se comprometer.
  • Fundadores preparando a proxima conversa de funding com tese concreta sobre China.

cn.name: 中国桥接冲刺营
cn.description: 为期六周的强化项目，帮助拉美团队在投入中国市场前完成需求验证、定位检验与分销对接。
cn.detailSubtitle: 聚焦验证的短期冲刺，适合在正式投入中国市场之前需要明确答案的团队。
cn.metaTitle: 中国桥接冲刺营 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 六周冲刺项目，帮助拉美团队在进入中国前完成需求、定位与渠道伙伴的验证。
cn.bodyHtml:
中国桥接冲刺营为已经看到中国机会、但仍需验证再投入的团队提供为期六周的密集项目。我们聚焦三个问题：真实需求、正确定位与合适的首选合作伙伴。

适合谁

  • 对中国有初步兴趣、探索预算有限的拉美团队。
  • 需要在正式投入前结构化测试的运营者。
  • 需要以具体中国战略支撑下一轮融资沟通的创始人。
